data.name: Rahim
data.gender_notes: Rahim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rahim is a name that signifies compassion, mercy, and love. It reflects the qualities of Allah, who is known for His mercy and kindness. This name is a reminder of the importance of being compassionate towards others. The name Rahim carries the meaning “Compassionate, Merciful, Loving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rahim usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate, merciful, loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rahim is derived from the Arabic word 'rahma,' which means mercy or compassion. This name is a reflection of Allah's attribute of mercy and is a reminder to His servants to be compassionate and merciful towards one another.
data.etymology: Rahim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate, Merciful, Loving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahim total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رحيم
in_arabic.meaning: الرحيم هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الرحمة والمغفرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرحيم مشتق من الرحمة، وهي من صفات الله تعالى، يعني الذي يرحم عباده ويسامحهم، ورد اسم الله الرحيم في القرآن الكريم أكثر من 70 مرة، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن مرتبطة بالله تعالى، مثل الرحمن الرحيم

in_urdu.name: رحیم
in_urdu.meaning: رحیم اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، رحمت اور مغفرت کا مطلب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحیم عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر 'رحم' سے جس کا مطلب ہے رحمت یا ہمدردی، اسلامی روایت میں رحیم رحمانی صفات کے ساتھ وابستہ ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: रहीम
in_hindi.meaning: रहीम का अर्थ है दयालु, यह अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहीम नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जो दया और करुणा की भावना को दर्शाता है, इस्लामी परंपरा में, रहीम नाम भगवान की दयालुता और क्षमा से जुड़ा हुआ है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: رحیم
in_pashto.meaning: رحیم د الله ښو نومونو څخه يو دی، د رحمت او مغفرت معنی یې ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحیم په عربي ژبه کې د 'رحم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د رحمت یا همدردۍ معنی لري، په افغاني او پښتني دودیزو ټولنو کې، دا نوم د الهي رحمت او مهربانۍ د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Rahim
in_english.meaning: Rahim means merciful, one of the most beautiful names of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahim is derived from the Arabic root 'رحم' (raḥm), which means mercy or compassion, it is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islam, signifying the merciful and compassionate nature of God, mentioned over 70 times in the Quran

It is often used as a title of respect and affection towards someone who embodies the qualities of compassion, mercy, and love. In some Muslim communities, it is a common name for both boys and girls.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Rahim" is a constant reminder of Allah's infinite compassion and mercy. This name encourages us to strive to be more compassionate, merciful, and loving towards others and ourselves, as we seek to emulate the attributes of Allah.
